subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost adopt a fixed 30-second opening-handshake limit, accepting that slower successful upgrades will instead enter the reconnect loop?
rationale: The code and proof establish that the timeout works, but repository evidence cannot determine the intended operational tolerance for slow self-hosted Mattermost proxies.

options.title: Accept the 30-second bound
options.body: Land the current internal timeout because it matches sibling WebSocket clients and prevents an individual handshake from pinning reconnect indefinitely.

options.title: Adjust the boundary first
options.body: Choose a different fixed limit or require additional slow-proxy evidence before merging if Mattermost deployments are expected to exceed 30 seconds.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second bound
recommendation.body: Land the current internal timeout because it matches sibling WebSocket clients and prevents an individual handshake from pinning reconnect indefinitely.
